purpose: Core-owned recovery knowledge for commercial readiness, app adapter support, and render-only consumer output.

principles.name: Recovery readiness foundation
principles.summary: Recovery readiness combines rest, fatigue, strain, sleep, trend stability, and confidence evidence into a Core-owned readiness context.
principles.coreRule: Applications may render recovery readiness output only and must not compute readiness locally.

principles.name: Evidence-based recovery context
principles.summary: Recovery interpretation should identify what evidence is present, what evidence is missing, and how uncertainty affects recommendations.
principles.coreRule: Core owns missing evidence, confidence limitations, and next-action reasoning.

principles.name: Cross-domain recovery influence
principles.summary: Recovery can affect movement readiness, cognitive stability, medication safety context, and risk tolerance.
principles.coreRule: Cross-domain effects must remain Core-owned and app consumers must not duplicate scoring.
